gripOrHq.title: Trojan Horse
gripOrHq.rulesText: Play only if Runner stole any agendas during his or her last turn. Give Runner a tag.

gripOrHq.title: Hacker Tracker Central
gripOrHq.rulesText: After each trace attempt, whether successful or not, put 1 from the bank on Hacker Tracker Central. During a trace attempt, each bit you spend from Hacker Tracker Central increases by 1 both your trace value and your trace limit.

gripOrHq.title: Employee Empowerment
gripOrHq.rulesText: You may choose to draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns. [A]: Draw two cards.

gripOrHq.title: Bioweapons Engineering
gripOrHq.rulesText: Each source of meat damage inflicts +1 meat damage.

heapOrArchives.title: Setup!
heapOrArchives.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

heapOrArchives.title: Rockerboy Promotion
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [15] from the bank on Rockerboy Promotion when you rez it. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rockerboy Promotion. A: Take [3] from Rockerboy Promotion.

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: Chance Observation
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during last turn. Trace 5 - If successful, give Runner 1 tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Urban Renewal
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Do 5 meat damage.

heapOrArchives.title: Corprunner's Shattered Remains
heapOrArchives.rulesText: You may advance Shattered Remains before and after you rez it. When Runner accesses Shattered Remains, trash one piece of hardware for each advancement counter on it.

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

heapOrArchives.title: BBS Whispering Campaign
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Put [16] from the bank on BBS Whispering Campaign when you rez it.  When all the bits have been removed, trash BBS Whispering Campaign. A: Take [2] from BBS Whispering Campaign.

scoreArea.title: Project Babylon
scoreArea.rulesText: Score 1 additional agenda point for every two advancement counters over Project Babylon's difficulty that are on Project Babylon when you score it.

discardCards.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
discardCards.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

discardCards.title: Krash
discardCards.rulesText:
2 credits: Break ice subroutine.
2 credits: +1 strength.

discardCards.title: HQ Interface
discardCards.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

discardCards.title: HQ Interface
discardCards.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

discardCards.title: All-Nighter
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

discardCards.title: All-Nighter
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

discardCards.title: Snowball
discardCards.rulesText:
Snowball has +1 strength for each subroutine it has broken during a run, until the end of that run.
[1]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.

discardCards.title: Private LDL Access
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, treat run as a successful run on R&D.

discardCards.title: Executive Wiretaps
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If successful, access two additional cards from HQ.

rig.title: HQ Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from HQ, access one additional card from HQ.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

ice.title: Hunter
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a tag.

ice.title: TKO 2.0
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] End the run, and Runner forgoes his or her next action.

ice.rulesText:

[Subroutine] End the run.

root.title: Vapor Ops
root.rulesText:
You may advance Vapor Ops before and after you rez it.
Vapor Ops advancement counter: Gain [1].
A: Move any number of advancement counters from Vapor Ops to another installed card that can be advanced.

ice.title: Fang
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 4 - If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [2].

ice.title: Fatal Attractor
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] The next time Runner encounters a piece of ice during the run, do 3 Net damage unless Runner breaks all subroutines of that piece of ice.

ice.title: Rex
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Trace 3 - If trace is successful, end the run, and Runner cannot run again until Runner takes an action to pay [2].

removedFromGame.title: MIT West Tier
removedFromGame.rulesText: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.
